items.question: What secured private network does the UAE Federal Network (FedNet) use to protect connected government entities?
items.gold: FedNet uses the secured and private Multi-protocol Label Switching (MPLS) cloud network.
items.fact: FedNet secure architecture uses MPLS private network cloud

items.question: Does the UAE Federal Network (FedNet) design contain single points of failure in its network structure?
items.gold: No, there are no single points of failure within the FedNet network structure.
items.fact: FedNet high availability design has no single points of failure
